row: The Greater Buffalo Veterinary Emergency Clinic is 100% dedicated to the after-hours practice of urgent care and emergency medicine. It is all we do. You depend on your veterinarian for your pet’s overall health. But, when your veterinarian is not available, our team of highly trained professionals is prepared to step in fast. Emergency intervention is what we are trained to do. It is our passion.
